RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceFor:
We're developing a device for talking with POKéMON.
But we haven't had much success…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Developin:
I'm developing new kinds of POKé BALLS…
But I haven't made much headway…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinally:
We finally made new kinds of POKé BALLS!
The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to catch POKéMON you've caught before.
The TIMER BALL gets better at catching POKéMON the longer a battle runs.
Both are proudly developed by the DEVON CORPORATION.
Please give them a try!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePoke:
I made the POKéNAV!
As an engineer, I feel blessed to have made something so great!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsA:
Oh, wow! That's a POKéNAV!
It came about as a result of our PRESIDENT's desire to learn about the feelings of POKéMON.
Would you like me to describe its features in detail?
No, no. I think you'll find out just by trying the POKéNAV out.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToV:
I'm trying to develop a device that visually reproduces the dreams of POKéMON…
But it's not going well.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDe:
I've been trying to develop a device that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…
And, it's working!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBri:
Wait! That thing you have there… Is that a POKéMON fossil?
Would you like to bring that POKéMON back to life?
I can with my newly developed FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatS:
Oh, is that so?
DEVON's technological expertise is outstanding, I tell you.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossil:
Oh, now that's a surprise! You have not one, but two, fossils?
Unfortunately, my machine can only regenerate one POKéMON at a time.
Would you like to pick one of your fossils for regeneration?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFos:
Excellent! Let's do this right away.
{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to the DEVON RESEARCHER.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilReg:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made, is incredible.
But it has one drawback--it takes a long time to work.
So, uh… How about you go for a stroll and look around for a while?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Fossilize:
Thanks for waiting!
Your fossilized POKéMON has been brought back to life!
The fossil was an ancient POKéMON. {STR_VAR_2}, it was!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPo: Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON. You have no room for this one.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNe:
I'm trying to develop a new feature for the POKéNAV…
But it's not going well.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWor:
Well, now what shall I work on developing next?
Our company allows us to make our inspirations into reality.
One couldn't ask for a better environment as an engineer.
